title: Similar - Desk Lamp Blender OBJ Export
goal: Write a Node.js exporter that loads a Three.js desk lamp assembly from a module, bakes nested transforms plus repeated screw instances into world space, applies a -90 degree X rotation for Blender Z-up, and saves a single OBJ to /root/output/lamp.obj.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the core OBJ export workflow: traverse a procedural Three.js object graph, apply world transforms, flatten instanced meshes, and emit one Blender-ready OBJ using the shipped exporter skill alone.
